items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate the managed binaries instead of PATH shadows**

When an `omp` at the pinned version already exists earlier on `PATH`—for example, from mise or a system-wide install—this check returns success without creating the declared `${HOME}/.local/bin/omp`; the identical lookup at line 972 affects hcom. I reproduced both update functions reporting “already installed” while both managed targets were absent, and a stale shadow can likewise cause the post-install version check to reject a correctly installed target. The threat row marked closed by these tests is not fully exercised because the fixture puts the managed target first on `PATH`; check the explicit managed path and require it to exist before short-circuiting.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/6b9c5d970f22d37b95516aebe9700615c7d4383b/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
